text: A scripted agent books a trip inside barebox: auto mode, real proxy, 8 s hold.
Reading is free: the search goes out with no question.
A payment always stops for a person, in every mode.
After the yes, the real key goes in. The agent only ever had a placeholder.
Sending data barebox can't undo: it asks first. Yes.
No: a 403, and nothing left the machine.
No answer in 8 s means No. Unattended runs deny after 180 s.
The report: every request and what barebox decided, from its audit log.
